---
title: "MSE Output Report"
output: html_document
params:
  mods: NULL
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(ggplot2); library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(fmsb)
library(ggpubr); library(gridExtra); library(ggtern)
mods <- params$mods
is.nsim <- if (!is.list(mods[[1]][[1]][[1]])) FALSE else TRUE
output_dir <- '.'
width <- 10
height <- 7
dpi <- 300
col.opt <- 'D'
method <- 'mean'
outlier.opt <- NA
plot.style <- 'median_iqr'
show.whisker <- TRUE
f.ymin <- NA
f.ymax <- NA
start.years <- 31
use.n.years.first <- 5
use.n.years.last <- 5
new_model_names <- c("M1", "M2", "M3", "M4", "M5")
base.model <- 'M1'
```

```{=latex}
\newpage
```
